name: Misfortune
description: Bad Luck, Calamity, Accidents, Failure, Ruin.

offensive.name: Everything Goes Wrong
offensive.description: The damage is incidental. The timing is the weapon.

tiers.text: +2 dice. The target's next attack roll or ability check has disadvantage.
tiers.card: +2 dice · disadvantage on their next attack or check

tiers.text: +4 dice. The target subtracts 1d4 from its next d20 roll of any kind.
tiers.card: +4 dice · −1d4 on their next d20 of any kind

tiers.text: +6 dice. The target's critical hits become normal hits for 1 minute, and on a natural 1 it takes this damage again.
tiers.card: +6 dice · their crits become normal hits 1 min · a natural 1 repeats this damage

tiers.text: +8 dice. For 1 minute the target rolls every d20 twice and takes the lower result.
tiers.card: +8 dice · 1 min: every d20 they roll is twice, taking the lower

supportive.name: Borrowed Luck
supportive.description: Your bad day, aimed somewhere useful.

tiers.text: For 1 minute, any creature attacking the target subtracts 1d4 from the roll.
tiers.card: 1 min: anyone attacking them subtracts 1d4

tiers.text: 1d6, and once per turn an attacker's damage roll drops its highest die.
tiers.card: 1d6 · once per turn an attacker drops their highest damage die

tiers.text: 1d8, and the first critical hit scored against the creature becomes a miss.
tiers.card: 1d8 · the first crit against them becomes a miss

tiers.text: Once per round, an attack against the creature simply misses — the strap breaks, the footing goes, the torch gutters.
tiers.card: 1/round an attack on them simply misses — the strap breaks, the footing goes

tiers.text: Choose one target — they subtract 1d4 from their next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw before the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: −1d4 on their next attack, check or save

tiers.text: On a failed Wisdom save, the target must reroll their next successful saving throw and take the lower result. This triggers once before the effect ends.
tiers.card: Wis save or their next successful save is rerolled at the lower result

tiers.text: Once per round as a reaction, when a creature within 60 feet succeeds on a saving throw, you may force them to reroll it — they must take the new result.
tiers.card: 1/round react to a successful save within 60 ft and force a reroll — new result stands

tiers.text: For 1 minute on a failed save, the target rolls all saving throws with disadvantage. They may repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of their turns to end the effect early.
tiers.card: 1 min: all their saves at disadvantage (Wis save at end of each turn to end it)

control.name: Chain of Calamity
control.description: Bad luck cascades into greater disaster.

tiers.text: If a creature fails a saving throw against your effect, the nearest creature within 10 feet must make a Dexterity save or suffer 1d6 damage of the same type.
tiers.card: A failed save splashes — nearest creature within 10 ft: Dex save or 1d6 of the same type

tiers.text: Chain to up to 2 creatures within 30 feet. If the first creature fails their save, each chained creature rolls their next saving throw with disadvantage.
tiers.card: Chains to 2 within 30 ft · each chained creature's next save is at disadvantage

tiers.text: When a creature affected by this effect fails a saving throw, one creature of your choice within 15 feet must make the same saving throw against a DC of 10 or suffer the same condition (not damage) as a ripple of misfortune.
tiers.card: A failure forces one creature within 15 ft to make the same save at DC 10 or share the condition

tiers.text: When a creature within 60 feet rolls a critical failure (natural 1 on a save or attack), trigger a Calamity — they are immediately subjected to one additional effect of your choice: Stunned until end of next turn, knocked Prone, or Cursed with disadvantage on their next saving throw.
tiers.card: A natural 1 within 60 ft triggers a Calamity — one extra effect of your choice lands on them

control.name: Cursed Timing
control.description: The wrong action at the worst time.

tiers.text: A creature affected has disadvantage on opportunity attacks and reaction-based effects until the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: Disadvantage on opportunity attacks and reactions until end of your next turn

penalty.disadvantage: opportunity attacks and reaction-based effects unt

tiers.text: Their initiative score drops by 5 for the remainder of the encounter, as misfortune robs them of their sense of timing.
tiers.card: Their initiative drops by 5 for the rest of the encounter

tiers.text: On a failed save, the target expends one use of Legendary Resistance if they have any remaining. If they have none, they instead have disadvantage on their next saving throw.
tiers.card: Fail: burns one Legendary Resistance · with none left, disadvantage on their next save

tiers.text: Once per long rest, designate one creature — until the end of their next turn they cannot use bonus actions or reactions, as every opportunity they reach for slips away at the last moment.
tiers.card: 1/long rest: no bonus actions or reactions until end of their next turn

tiers.text: If a creature rolls a natural 20 on an attack roll, they must reroll it — if the reroll is 10 or lower, the attack misses and backfires in a minor way at DM discretion.
tiers.card: A natural 20 on an attack must be rerolled — 10 or lower and it misses and backfires

tiers.text: The target's next critical hit becomes a normal hit, and they take psychic damage equal to your spellcasting modifier as their fortune inverts.
tiers.card: Their next crit becomes a normal hit and deals them {VM} psychic as fortune inverts

tiers.text: Once per long rest as a reaction, you may convert one instance of advantage a creature within 60 feet has into disadvantage before they roll.
tiers.card: 1/long rest react to turn one creature's advantage into disadvantage before they roll

tiers.text: Mark a creature with Cursed Glory for 1 minute — if they roll a natural 20 on any roll, they immediately take psychic damage equal to twice your spellcasting modifier, and the natural 20 is treated as a natural 1 instead.
tiers.card: Cursed Glory 1 min — every natural 20 they roll costs them 2×{VM} psychic and counts as a 1

utility.name: Small Ruin
utility.description: It arrives as a slightly wet cobblestone at exactly the wrong moment.

tiers.text: A nonmagical object you touch fails the next time it is relied on — a strap, a bowstring, a hinge, a lock. Lose a pursuer to ordinary coincidence. Know the one thing most likely to go wrong here.
tiers.card: An object you touch fails next time it's relied on · lose a pursuer to coincidence

tiers.text: For 8 hours, a creature you name has a bad day — wrong turns, spoiled food, missed meetings, misheard orders. Nothing provable, and nothing a saving throw can answer.
tiers.card: 8 hrs of a bad day for a named creature — nothing provable, nothing a save can answer

tiers.text: Ruin a plan rather than a person — a shipment goes astray, a message is delivered to the wrong hand, a ceremony is interrupted by something mundane and humiliating.
tiers.card: Ruin a plan instead of a person — a shipment astray, a message misdelivered, a ceremony spoiled

tiers.text: Curse an endeavor — a voyage, a siege, a marriage, a harvest — for a season. It does not fail dramatically. It simply never quite works, and no one can say why.
tiers.card: Curse an endeavour for a season. It never quite works, and no one can say why

complementEffects.name: Hex Touch
complementEffects.description: The spell leaves a lingering curse where it lands.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw against the primary effect, the target is hexed — they suffer a −1d4 penalty to one type of roll of your choice (attack rolls, saving throws, or ability checks) until the end of their next turn.
effect.card: Hexed — −1d4 on one roll type of your choice

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The penalty increases to −1d6, and you may apply it to two types of rolls simultaneously.
upgrades.card: −1d6 · applies to two roll types at once

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The hex persists for 1 minute, and once per turn when the hexed creature rolls the affected roll type, they must reroll one die and take the lower result.
upgrades.card: Lasts 1 min · once per turn they reroll and take the worse

complementEffects.name: Deflect Ill Omen
complementEffects.description: The curse finds someone else to land on.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one ally of your choice within 30 feet gains the Deflection benefit — the next time they would fail a saving throw or ability check before the start of your next turn, they may reroll it once and take the higher result.
effect.card: An ally within 30 ft rerolls their next failed save or check

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The ally may apply this reroll to attack rolls as well, and the benefit persists until the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: Covers attack rolls too · lasts until your next turn

upgrades.text: Level 11+: You may choose two allies to receive this benefit, and each reroll gains a +2 bonus.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, that target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Verum DC or fall prone as misfortune finds the one uneven stone, the one slick patch, the one moment their balance was not quite right.

upgrades.text: Level 5+: On a failed save, the target also has their movement speed halved until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: Fail also halves their speed until end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Creatures that fail also have disadvantage on the first attack roll they make after standing up.
upgrades.card: Also disadvantage on their first attack after standing

penalty.disadvantage: the first attack roll they make after standing up
